_comment: Approved wording shown with workshop cards. 'trialIntro.lead' + 'trialIntro.trialClaims' together form the plural intro, shown once on a page whose cards are all trial. On a page with any tenant card, only 'lead' is shown as the shared intro; each tenant card gets 'tenantCard' and each trial card gets 'trialCard'. A page may replace the plural intro with its own trialIntro {en, ms} in its data file; a missing or blank value keeps this shared intro, including the mixed-page lead-only rule. Pages with no workshop show none of this. {{ brand }} comes from site.json and {{ workshop.name }} from routing.json. The build refuses TODO wording on a page that needs it.

lead.en: Here are well-reviewed local workshops for this area. Call or WhatsApp them directly.
lead.ms: Berikut ialah bengkel tempatan yang mendapat ulasan baik di kawasan ini. Hubungi atau WhatsApp mereka terus.

trialClaims.en: {{ brand }} is an independent guide and isn't affiliated with them. Chosen from public Google reviews and, where known, years in business. We aren't paid by the workshops we suggest.
trialClaims.ms: {{ brand }} ialah panduan bebas dan tidak bergabung dengan bengkel-bengkel ini. Dipilih berdasarkan ulasan Google awam dan, jika diketahui, tempoh beroperasi. Kami tidak dibayar oleh bengkel yang kami cadangkan.

tenantCard.en: {{ brand }} is a car workshop guide. {{ workshop.name }} pays {{ brand }} a flat fee to be featured here. It doesn't change the price they quote you.
tenantCard.ms: {{ brand }} ialah panduan bengkel kereta. {{ workshop.name }} membayar yuran tetap kepada {{ brand }} untuk dipaparkan di sini. Ia tidak mengubah harga yang mereka sebut kepada anda.

trialCard.en: {{ brand }} isn't affiliated with {{ workshop.name }}. Chosen from public Google reviews and, where known, years in business. {{ workshop.name }} doesn't pay us.
trialCard.ms: {{ brand }} tidak bergabung dengan {{ workshop.name }}. Dipilih berdasarkan ulasan Google awam dan, jika diketahui, tempoh beroperasi. {{ workshop.name }} tidak membayar kami.
